statusLabel: Supported, Not New — real Tier 1, boosted by CORI
summary: Elfnote is NOT a Chaos Origins original — it debuted roughly 9 months earlier in Burst Protocol. CORI adds Elfnote June Pride, the Synchro closer that completes the archetype's game plan. Level 6 Spellcaster monsters built around shuffling through the Center Main Monster Zone, paired with a Synchron sub-engine. Confirmed real and strong: 106 of 1,084 tracked OCG Top-cut decks in the Apr–Jun 2026 season ran Elfnote, and a "Kewl Tune Elfnote" hybrid (piloted by ぽとふ) took 1st place at the 9th Midnight kinta CS in Tokyo on June 28, 2026.

cards.name: Elfnote June Pride
cards.effectText: CORI-EN035. Materials: 1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Spellcaster monster. While this card is in the center Main Monster Zone, neither player can declare an attack except with a monster in their own center Main Monster Zone. During your Main Phase, if this card is in the center Main Monster Zone (Quick Effect): return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon up to 1 "Elfnote" monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY. Once per turn. Widely described as the card that "completes" the archetype — this is CORI's only new Elfnote-named card.

cards.name: Elfnote Regina
cards.effectText: Pre-CORI starter piece (Burst Protocol) — can Special Summon itself under the right conditions and adds any Elfnote monster from the Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Elfnote Fortuna
cards.effectText: Pre-CORI (Burst Protocol) — places a card referred to as 'Rhapsodia of Madness,' can Special Summon itself from the GY, and can negate a face-up card on the field.

cards.name: Elfnote Power Patron
cards.effectText: Pre-CORI (Burst Protocol) — raises Elfnote Regina's Level, which is what enables Synchro Summoning Elfnote June Pride.

cards.name: Medius the Pure
cards.effectText: Cross-archetype tutor target shared with Artmage and DoomZ — can be Special Summoned from hand or Deck if you control an Artmage, DoomZ, or Elfnote card.

comboLines.title: Center Monster Zone shuffle into June Pride
comboLines.body: Elfnote's signature play is cycling monsters through the Center Main Monster Zone to set up Synchro Summons. Use Elfnote Power Patron to raise Elfnote Regina's Level to the right number, Synchro Summon Elfnote June Pride (Tuner + non-Tuner Spellcaster — a Synchron like Jet Synchron works fine as the Tuner), then bounce June Pride back to the Extra Deck on a later Main Phase to reload up to 3 more Elfnote monsters from hand, Deck, and GY.

comboLines.title: The real meta build hybridizes with Kewl Tune
comboLines.body: The highest-profile confirmed 2026 result for this archetype (1st place, Midnight kinta CS, Tokyo) was piloted as "Kewl Tune Elfnote" — a hybrid with the all-Tuner Kewl Tune Synchro engine (from Blazing Dominion, the Core Booster just before CORI), which is itself the single most-played deck in the OCG this season. This site's sample list below is the pure Elfnote + Synchron shell rather than the full Kewl Tune hybrid, since the exact hybrid counts weren't retrievable from this environment.

sampleDecklist.label: Elfnote is real Tier 1 (106/1,084 tracked OCG Top-cut decks) with a confirmed tournament win: "Kewl Tune Elfnote" by ぽとふ, 1st place, 9th Midnight kinta CS, Tokyo, June 28 2026. This list is the core Elfnote + Synchron shell closed out by CORI's June Pride — it is not the exact Kewl Tune hybrid list from that win, which wasn't fully extractable from this environment.
